title: Approximation of Singular-Stopping Control Driven by Hawkes Processes via Rescaled MDPs
summary: We investigate a singular-optimal stopping stochastic control problem driven by self-exciting dynamics governed by a Hawkes process. In the continuous-time setting, we show that the optimization problem reduces to solving a variational partial differential equation with gradient constraints. We then introduce its discrete-time counterpart, modeled as a Markov Decision Process.
